nodes.name: Semantic Tag Auto-Capture Plan (v0.5.2)
nodes.summary: Step-by-step TDD implementation plan for adding a 5-layer `extractSemanticTags()` function to the VS Code extension that automatically attaches meaningful semantic tags to every auto-captured memory record on file save. The plan covers helper functions (`withTimeout`, `getGitBranch`, `getDocumentSymbolTags`), wiring into `onDidSaveTextDocument` and the `hipcortex.addMemory` command palette, 10 new Jest tests, and a VSIX rebuild to v0.5.2. No backend changes required — the server already stores tags.

nodes.name: Server Lifecycle Option A Plan (v0.5.4)
nodes.summary: Detailed TDD plan for implementing robust VS Code extension local-server lifecycle management: dynamic port parsing from `apiUrl`, version-aware reuse/restart policy (strict vs major.minor), safe port reclaim via `killProcessOnPort`, and `deactivate()` child-process cleanup. Introduces `EXPECTED_SERVER_VERSION`, `extractPortFromBaseUrl`, `isServerVersionAcceptable`, and `shouldReuseRunningServer` as exported pure helpers, plus a rewrite of `doAutoStartServer`. Targets extension v0.5.4 VSIX with 11 new unit tests.

nodes.name: Cross-Channel UX Enhancement Plan (8-Phase)
nodes.summary: Comprehensive 8-phase plan to unify HipCortex across all client channels (Claude Code, VS Code VSIX, pip, MCP, npm, agent frameworks) by introducing a project config file, a `hipcortex doctor` command, a single shared daemon attach model, an OpenAPI-derived capability matrix, idempotent install wizard v2, and host-specific installers for Antigravity, Hermes, OpenClaw, and Grok. Phases 0–8 are recorded as complete as of 2026-07-19. Success metrics target sub-5-minute first-recall time and exactly one server process per machine.

nodes.name: Intelligence Layer Wiring Design Spec
nodes.summary: Approved architecture design for connecting the previously isolated intelligence modules (WorldModelEnhanced, AureusBridge, SelfModel, CoherenceChecker) to the REST API via a new `AppState<B>` struct replacing the flat `run_with_both_stores` signature. Specifies 9 new REST endpoints, automatic WorldModel feeding on every memory add/ingest, JSON snapshot persistence for WorldModel (`worldmodel.json`) with atomic writes and periodic 5-minute flush, and advisory-only SelfModel gating. Documents key decisions: tuple-key encoding for HashMap serialization, RwLock vs Mutex choices, and out-of-scope items.

nodes.name: Query Response Full Field Exposure Design Spec
nodes.summary: Approved minimal design spec for expanding `MemoryRecordResponse` (used by `/memory/query`, `/memory/search`, `/memory/latest`) from 8 fields to 15 by adding `confidence`, `source`, `priority`, `tags`, `version`, `status`, and `expires_at`. Identifies all 4 struct construction sites in `web_server.rs` that need updating, including the export handler. Backward compatible — new fields are additive only.
